ui_bugs.issue: After a 'Related publishing work' jump, the target's top lands at 0, under the 64px sticky header, so the top of the screenshot is hidden. Add scroll-margin-top (e.g. scroll-mt-24) to the #project-<id> wrappers.

Loading /work#project-hana directly does not scroll to the anchor (scrollY stays 0; the element is at 4009px). The SPA scroll-to-top or a late render overrides the hash. Shared links to a project will not land on it.

issues: Habesha Press and Hana the Hyena sit side by side in the same 2-col row at desktop, so the cross-link jump barely moves the page. Acceptable, but the related link mostly helps on mobile.
Every card's link reads 'Visit site'. aria-labels tell them apart (good), but sighted users of the Oakrange two-part card see two identical 'Visit site' links. Consider 'Visit portal'.

action_items: (LOW) Add scroll-margin-top to the #project-<id> wrappers on /work so anchor jumps clear the sticky header
(LOW) Handle the location.hash on /work load (scroll to the element after render) so /work#project-<id> deep links work
critical_code_review_comments: Seo.jsx sets og:image to window.location.origin on non-canonical hosts. Fine for preview, but social crawlers don't run JS, so they only see the static index.html tags (adzenmedia.com/og-image.jpg). That is correct for production.

ReviewNote text says screenshots are hidden on adzenmedia.com, but showPortfolio() also returns true when PORTFOLIO_APPROVED. When approval flips, the note would still render on preview hosts. Gate the note on !PORTFOLIO_APPROVED.
The email wordmark is 360x61 but rendered at 180x30 (ratio 6.0 vs 5.9), a negligible squash. height=31 or a 360x60 asset would be exact.
The founder email dashboard link uses APP_URL (currently the cc90a1ee preview host). Make sure production APP_URL is https://adzenmedia.com, or the link and logo point at preview.
